name: Claim Payment Information
sourceRefs: PyX12 (azoner/pyx12) 835.5010.X221.A1.xml — the authoritative source for this segment. CLP10 (Patient Status Code) and CLP14 (Yes/No Condition or Response Code) are marked usage="N" (Not Used) by this specific Implementation Guide even though the base X12 5010 standard defines them; this schema omits N positions entirely rather than modeling forbidden fields. The segment ends at position 14 in 5010/X221 — no CLP15/16 exist in this IG at all.

SUPERSEDES an earlier version of this file built from Stedi's generic (unversioned, defaulting to X12 Release 8010) segment page, which showed a materially different and incorrect 11-16 range (Health Care Code Information composite, Percentage, Exchange Rate, Source of Payment Typology Code) — a real version-mismatch bug caught during a user-requested thoroughness re-verification pass.
